scope: Current CoreFoundation XML plist date encoding discards subsecond precision for these positive timestamps. This checks serialization, not the exact powermetrics timestamp call site.

cases.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<date>2026-10-25T17:48:12Z</date>
</plist>
